title: Mindbreak
description:
I think it’s so hot when strong-willed boys come into my web to play. You’ll have plenty of opportunities to resist me and show me that you aren’t really addicted to hypnosis, you can’t be broken by a hot, dominant brat like me.
But if you do accidentally end up falling…if you let your guard down for a second… I get to control you. I get to push your limits, hold you on the edge, and make you mine.
CW: This is a hypnosis trap designed to make you hopelessly addicted to my voice, my control, edging, and the unbearable need for my permission to cum. Which, of course, you’ll never get, because I make you continue to loop the file, until you break.
There are homewrecking mentions. I don’t care if you have a wife or girlfriend, I want you obsessing over over me and my voice. You’re mine.
There are no safeties or safe words, because that turns me on the most. And Nichole comes first. Listen at your own discretion.
author: Goddess Nichole
